errors.evidence:
Thought: I must locate and extract quantitative measurements from two separate peer‑reviewed papers. One paper by Omar Valencfia‑Mendez (2017) reports the total length of the harlequin shrimp; the other by G. Curt Fiedler (2002) reports the length (or the feeding unit size) of the sea star that was fed to that shrimp. Once both numbers are identified – ensuring the units match – I will compute the ratio (sea star length divided by shrimp total length multiplied by 100) and then round to the nearest integer. I will now ask our search_agent for help in finding these exact numerical values with as much context as possible.

Code:
py
 task = (
    "Hello search_agent, please help me gather the following information: "
    "1. From the paper by Omar Valencfia-Mendez (2017) on harlequin shrimp, what is the total length recorded for the shrimp (include unit, e.g. mm)? "
    "2. From the paper by G. Curt Fiedler (2002) involving the feeding of the same type of shrimp, what is the measurement given for the sea star that was fed to those shrimp (include unit)? "
    "I need the exact numbers so I can compute the percentage: (sea star measurement / shrimp total length)*100, rounded to an integer. Please provide the extracted numbers and any context needed."
)
print(task)
